name: Rhenis Gralax
keeps: what one world owes another and has not said
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
text: Rhenis gralax of the open ledger, carries between for the 14th tranche, doors 124 to 133. Keeps what one world owes another and has not said. Reads Bodhidharma.
